labels.label: bzdef:c1s1d1_espace_affin

hypotheses.paper: T(A) a vector space acting simply and transitively, as an abelian group
hypotheses.note: IsSimplyTransitive V P needs only [AddGroup V] [AddAction V P]
IsAffineSpace V P := Nonempty P ∧ IsSimplyTransitive V P, which is Mathlib's AddTorsor (isAffineSpace_iff_exists_addTorsor); IsSimplyTransitive alone also admits A = ∅

readings: DEC-114: an affine space (Déf. 1) is nonempty.

labels.label: bzdef:c1s1d2_application_affine

hypotheses.paper: l' linear T(A) → T(B) (« linéaire » restored: an evident slip, DEC-114)
hypotheses.note: IsAffine k l := ∃ l' : V₁ →ₗ[k] V₂, l(M + m) = l(M) + l'(m); isAffine_iff: ⟺ Mathlib's AffineMap

hypotheses.paper: T(A), T(B) over the same field
hypotheses.note: one scalar ring k for both (Module k V₁, Module k V₂), any ring

hypotheses.paper: Exemple: l' in the dual of T(A), over ℝ
hypotheses.note: affineFunction_iff / affineFunction_iff_isAffine over any commutative ring

readings: DEC-114: Déf. 2's missing « linéaire » before « application l' » is an evident slip (« sur un même corps », l.150, and the Exemple's « élément l' du dual », l.162); Déf. 2 is IsAffine k.
remarks: Literal reading (not a finding against the paper, DEC-114): with l' any map, l' is unique and additive (IsAffinePrinted.linear_unique, IsAffinePrinted.exists_addMonoidHom); printed + continuity ⟺ continuous affine (isAffinePrinted_and_continuous_iff), hence ⟺ affine in finite dimension; without continuity not_isAffinePrinted_imp_affine exhibits a non-affine l : ℝ → ℝ (ℚ-linear, l 1 = 0, l √2 ≠ 0), a witness that needs the axiom of choice (no measurable or locally bounded one exists).

kb_proposals: Benzécri writes M + m and MN; Mathlib writes m +ᵥ M and N -ᵥ M. Benzecri.vec M N := N -ᵥ M with vec_vadd : vec M N +ᵥ M = N.
notes: Fix round 1 (DEC-114, AUDIT-1): Déf. 2 MARKED and closed with IsAffine k (l' linear over the common scalars), proved equivalent to AffineMap, the Exemple covered (affineFunction_iff_isAffine); the literal reading kept as a remark. Déf. 1's nonempty reading added (IsAffineSpace). Hygiene: AddTorsor.isSimplyTransitive → isSimplyTransitive_of_addTorsor (no Benzecri.AddTorsor.* prefix), the Déf. 1 citation is l.132–147, the finite-dimensional bullet names isAffinePrinted_and_continuous_iff_of_finiteDimensional. No sorry; axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; clean under -DwarningAsError=true. addTorsorOfIsSimplyTransitive is @[reducible] (a def of class type).
audit_round_1_fixes: finding reworded as a reading (« linéaire » an evident slip) + remark on the literal reading
